findings.evidence: Their conclusions begin `weylGroupToPerm (longestElement …) '' posRoots/negRoots` and `longestElement … • dominantChamber`; the naming guide requires infix expressions to be read in expression order. Adjacent declarations follow this: `image_root_inversions` in `Inversions/Basic.lean:152` and `ofIdx_smul_notMem_dominantChamber` in `Chamber.lean:140`.
findings.fix: Rename them with the specialized actor before the operand, e.g. `image_weylGroupToPerm_longestElement_posRoots`, `image_weylGroupToPerm_longestElement_negRoots`, and `longestElement_smul_dominantChamber`.
findings.issue: `image_posRoots_longestElement`, `image_negRoots_longestElement` (line 253), and `smul_dominantChamber_longestElement` (line 327) reverse the syntactic order of the actor and operand, making them difficult to discover from their left-hand sides.

summary: Three action/image lemmas put `longestElement` after the acted-on set, contrary to expression order and adjacent naming precedent.
